# Novalix

> Novalix builds custom websites, web applications, business software, inventory systems, and Dine3D, a restaurant POS and operations platform. The website describes services, selected projects, pricing, and contact options.

Novalix has a Belgium business contact and works with clients remotely. Use the linked pages for current details; do not infer prices, availability, or results from this summary.

## Company and services

- [Home](https://www.novalix.tech/): Overview of Novalix and Dine3D.
- [Services](https://www.novalix.tech/services/): Websites, web apps, WordPress, Shopify, custom software, and inventory systems.
- [Pricing](https://www.novalix.tech/pricing/): Published package and estimate information.
- [About](https://www.novalix.tech/about/): Team approach and delivery standards.
- [Contact](https://www.novalix.tech/contact/): Project enquiries and contact information.

## Work

- [Projects](https://www.novalix.tech/projects/): Selected projects and case studies.
- [Dine3D](https://www.novalix.tech/projects/dine3d/): Restaurant POS, kitchen display, ordering, and inventory platform.
